technology_name: NARCICLASINE AND ROSIGLITAZONE BASED COMPOSITION TO MIMIC THE EFFECTS OF ISCHEMIC PRECONDITIONING AGAINST CEREBRAL STROKE
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Ischemic brain damage from cerebrovascular blockages requires immediate cellular-level protection pathways to prevent extensive long-term cognitive loss or motor paralysis.
description: An advanced small-molecule therapeutic formulation combining narciclasine compounds with rosiglitazone agents to supply an additive or synergistic neuroprotective effect that mimics stroke preconditioning.
applications: Acute ischemic stroke therapies, transient ischemic attack (TIA) clinical recovery drugs, cerebrovascular surgical safety formulations, and targeted neuro-intensive care medicine.
